$comment: Two Maine city ordinances still above the state's $15.10. Bangor repealed its own ordinance in 2017 and is deliberately absent.

tipped.note: Half the city rate, mirroring Maine's own 50% tip-credit cap.

scheduledChanges.note: Second step of the November 2025 voter-approved amendment; $19.00 in 2028.

sources.title: City of Portland, Maine minimum wage -- November 2025 voter-approved schedule
sources.verifiedBy: cross_source_confirmed this session (Portland's own page returned 503 to a direct fetch): roughly 63% of voters approved the initiative on 2025-11-04, taking the city rate to $16.75 for 2026, $17.75 for 2027 and $19.00 for 2028, with the tipped wage at half the city rate ($8.38).

tipped.note: Rockland requires a direct cash wage of at least $8.00 and the employer must make up any shortfall to $16.00.

sources.title: City of Rockland, Maine -- 2026 Minimum Wage Notice
sources.verifiedBy: cross_source_confirmed this session from the city's own posted 2026 minimum wage notice: $16.00 effective 2026-01-01 with an $8.00 direct wage for service employees.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Labor Center -- Inventory of US City and County Minimum Wage Ordinances
sources.verifiedBy: Fetched and read directly this session. The standing national census of local minimum wage ordinances -- used here to establish WHICH jurisdictions exist (so none is silently omitted), with each rate then cross-checked against a second source.

knownGaps: Portland's ordinance also carries a declared-emergency premium (1.5x the city minimum wage) that has been litigated; it is not modelled.

The exact in-force date of Portland's 2026 step was reported inconsistently by secondary sources (January 1 for private employers, July 1 for City of Portland employees); the January 1 figure is carried because it is the one the ordinance's own schedule and the tipped figure both key on.
